################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the convergence of the models 
################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
library(colorspace)
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
dirs$outputs <- "../outputs/perpathogen"
dirs$rhats <- "../outputs/modres_rhats"

pat_l <- c("rota", "varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "men", "pn", "polio", "hib",
           "dipht", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv", "ipv", "opv", "multi_men", "multi_hibmen", "multi_polio", 
           "multi_dtp", "multi_mmrv", "multi_mmr", "multi_pertu", "multi_pn", "multi_ipv", "multi_opv")
```

# Check convergence of the photoperiod models 
```{r}
rhats <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$rhats}/df_rhats_cs.rds"))
rhats %>%
  filter(Rhat == TRUE)

# pat_l <- c("hav", "ipv", "polio", "tetan", "multi_polio", "multi_ipv", "multi_dtp", "multi_dtpa", "multi_dtpw")
# Multi dtp 4
# Multi dtpw 3 and 4
# Muti hib-men 2, 3, 4, 6
# Muti men 2, 3, 4, 6
# Multi opv all
```

# Check convergence of the photoperiod-climate models 
```{r}
rhats <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$rhats}/df_rhats_cs2i.rds"))
rhats %>%
  filter(Rhat == FALSE) %>%
  arrange(pathogen, df) %>%
  filter(str_detect(pathogen, "multi"))

# converging:
# kgc_3 dipht, dtpa, polio, rota, 
# kgc_1 hbv, strep, men
# kgc_2 hib, ipv, pertu

# kgc_1 multi_dtp multi_dtpa multi_men 
# kgc_2 multi_pertu
# kgc_3 multi_polio 
```
